verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Mastra is Apache 2.0 licensed, can be self-hosted for $0/month, runs on Node.js/Bun/Deno/Cloudflare, and can be deployed to any Node.js-compatible environment or integrated into an existing web framework, indicating no vendor lock-in for core agent execution. A vendor-hosted 'Studio' exists but appears optional (a local Studio also runs at localhost:4111), and community discussion raises license nuance around offering Mastra itself as a hosted service to third parties, which is tangential to running it on one's own infra. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of a fully self-hosted production deployment with no vendor calls, and clarification of any licensing restrictions affecting self-hosting.
